ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New work, Proposal and later stages need Conflict check result, Billing model and Amount.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_work", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry", 1, "Qualified", 2, "Conflict check", 3, "Proposal", 4, "Proposal sent", 5, "Terms agreed", 6, "Engagement letter out", 7, "Closed won", 8, 0) >= 4, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Conflict_check_result__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Billing_model__c)), ISBLANK(Amount)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Conflict check result, Billing model and Amount before moving to Proposal.
